lyrics.ja: ※ただいま歌詞の翻訳はAIによる生成したものです。人工による翻訳は後ほどアップデートする予定です！
lyrics.en: ※This translation is currently generated by AI. The refined version is coming soon!
lyrics.zh: ※此翻譯暫時是AI生成的。人工的翻譯會容後更新！

lyrics.ja: 募りに募った想いはすでに　限界値
lyrics.romaji: Tsunori ni Tsunotta Omoi ha Sude ni Genkaichi
lyrics.en: These feelings that have piled up are already at their limit
lyrics.zh: 層層堆疊的思念早已到達極限

lyrics.ja: キミに会えた瞬間　巻き起こす　ビッグバン
lyrics.romaji: Kimi ni Aeta Shunkan Makiokosu Biggu Ban
lyrics.en: The moment I see you, a big bang erupts
lyrics.zh: 見到你的瞬間，引爆了大霹靂

lyrics.ja: 爆発的だね！離れていたからこそのドキドキ
lyrics.romaji: Bakuhatsuteki Da ne! Hanarete Ita kara Koso no Dokidoki
lyrics.en: It's explosive! The excitement comes precisely from being apart
lyrics.zh: 真是爆炸性呢！正因分離才有的心跳加速

lyrics.ja: 時間を忘れて　トキメキ宇宙飛行
lyrics.romaji: Jikan wo Wasurete Tokimeki Uchuu Hikou
lyrics.en: Forgetting time, a heart-fluttering space flight
lyrics.zh: 忘卻時間，心動的宇宙飛行

lyrics.ja: 目と目でコンタクト　キミと私　あうんの呼吸
lyrics.romaji: Me to Me de Kontakuto Kimi to Watashi Aun no Kokyuu
lyrics.en: Eye-to-eye contact, you and I breathe in perfect sync
lyrics.zh: 眼神交會，你我有著默契的呼吸

lyrics.ja: 心カラダ揺らして高めましょ　シンクロナイズ
lyrics.romaji: Kokoro Karada Yurashite Takamemasho Shinkuronaizu
lyrics.en: Let's shake our hearts and bodies and heighten—synchronize
lyrics.zh: 搖曳身心，一同昇華，同步共鳴

lyrics.ja: 非科学的なの　何でも叶いそうなこの予感
lyrics.romaji: Hikagakuteki na no Nani demo Kanai Sou na Kono Yokan
lyrics.en: It's unscientific—this feeling that anything could come true
lyrics.zh: 真不科學，這股彷彿萬事皆可成真的預感

lyrics.ja: 手を叩く度　風がフッと頬なでるカンジ
lyrics.romaji: Te wo Tataku Tabi Kaze ga Futto Hoho Naderu Kanji
lyrics.en: Every time I clap, the wind softly strokes my cheek
lyrics.zh: 每次拍手，風兒便輕輕拂過臉頰

lyrics.ja: 久しぶりのエモーション
lyrics.romaji: Hisashiburi no Emooshon
lyrics.en: An emotion I haven't felt in a while
lyrics.zh: 久違的情感

lyrics.ja: ハピハピ！キミを感じたいの
lyrics.romaji: Hapi Hapi! Kimi wo Kanjitai no
lyrics.en: Happy happy! I want to feel you
lyrics.zh: Happy Happy！好想感受你

lyrics.ja: ベリベリ！最高の気分なの
lyrics.romaji: Beri Beri! Saikou no Kibun na no
lyrics.en: Very very! I'm in the best mood
lyrics.zh: Very Very！心情好極了

lyrics.ja: はみ出す情熱も　震えてる声も
lyrics.romaji: Hamidasu Jounetsu mo Furueteru Koe mo
lyrics.en: Even this overflowing passion, even this trembling voice
lyrics.zh: 滿溢的熱情也好，顫抖的聲音也好

lyrics.ja: リアルに触れてよ　もっと深く
lyrics.romaji: Riaru ni Furete yo Motto Fukaku
lyrics.en: Touch me for real, more deeply
lyrics.zh: 真實地觸碰吧，更加深入

lyrics.ja: 繋がれ　シンパサイザー
lyrics.romaji: Tsunagare Shinpasaizaa
lyrics.en: Connect, sympathizer
lyrics.zh: 相連吧，共感者

lyrics.ja: ひとりぼっちの日は起動させて　プログラム
lyrics.romaji: Hitoribocchi no Hi ha Kidou Sasete Puroguramu
lyrics.en: On lonely days, boot up the program
lyrics.zh: 孤單的日子裡，啟動程式

lyrics.ja: 新しいキズナの形がほら　見えてくる
lyrics.romaji: Atarashii Kizuna no Katachi ga Hora Miete Kuru
lyrics.en: Look, a new form of bond becomes visible
lyrics.zh: 看啊，嶄新的羈絆形式逐漸浮現

lyrics.ja: 革命的でしょ？　当たり前が組み替えられてく
lyrics.romaji: Kakumteki Desho? Atarimae ga Kumikaerareteku
lyrics.en: Revolutionary, isn't it? The ordinary is being rearranged
lyrics.zh: 很革命性對吧？理所當然正被重新組合

lyrics.ja: WiFiひとつで　どんなキモチも伝え合える
lyrics.romaji: WiFi Hitotsu de Donna Kimochi mo Tsutaeaeru
lyrics.en: With just WiFi, we can share any feeling
lyrics.zh: 只要靠著WiFi，任何心情都能互相傳達

lyrics.ja: 奏で合える　これから
lyrics.romaji: Kanadeaeru Kore Kara
lyrics.en: From now on, we can play together
lyrics.zh: 從今以後，也能合奏共鳴

lyrics.ja: レディレディ！ハートあげていくよ
lyrics.romaji: Redi Redi! Haato Agete Iku yo
lyrics.en: Ready ready! I'll give you my heart
lyrics.zh: Ready Ready！要把心獻給你

lyrics.ja: ビリビリ！本気見せてみてよ
lyrics.romaji: Biri Biri! Honki Misete Mite yo
lyrics.en: Biri biri! Show me your true self
lyrics.zh: Biri Biri！讓我看看你的真心吧

lyrics.ja: 地球の裏だって　夜の淵だって
lyrics.romaji: Chikyuu no Ura Datte Yoru no Fuchi Datte
lyrics.en: Even the other side of the earth, even the edge of night
lyrics.zh: 哪怕是地球另一端，哪怕是黑夜邊緣

lyrics.ja: リモートで飛べるよ　もっと速く
lyrics.romaji: Rimooto de Toberu yo Motto Hayaku
lyrics.en: I can fly there remotely, even faster
lyrics.zh: 都能遠端飛越，更加迅速

lyrics.ja: 重なれ　シンパサイザー
lyrics.romaji: Kasanare Shinpasaizaa
lyrics.en: Overlap, sympathizer
lyrics.zh: 交疊吧，共感者

lyrics.ja: 秒速でキミに会いにいくよ
lyrics.romaji: Byousoku de Kimi ni Ai ni Iku yo
lyrics.en: I'll go see you at the speed of light
lyrics.zh: 以秒速前去見你

lyrics.ja: リア/リモ　今日はどちらにしよう？
lyrics.romaji: Ria / Rimo Kyou ha Dochira ni Shiyou?
lyrics.en: Real or remote—which shall we choose today?
lyrics.zh: 面對面還是遠端，今天選哪一個？

lyrics.ja: ハピハピ！キミを感じたいの
lyrics.romaji: Hapi Hapi! Kimi wo Kanjitai no
lyrics.en: Happy happy! I want to feel you
lyrics.zh: Happy Happy！好想感受你

lyrics.ja: ベリベリ！最高の気分なの
lyrics.romaji: Beri Beri! Saikou no Kibun na no
lyrics.en: Very very! I'm in the best mood
lyrics.zh: Very Very！心情好極了

lyrics.ja: はみ出す情熱も　震えてる声も
lyrics.romaji: Hamidasu Jounetsu mo Furueteru Koe mo
lyrics.en: Even this overflowing passion, even this trembling voice
lyrics.zh: 滿溢的熱情也好，顫抖的聲音也好

lyrics.ja: 自由に触れてよ　私たち
lyrics.romaji: Jiyuu ni Furete yo Watashitachi
lyrics.en: Touch freely—we
lyrics.zh: 自由地觸碰吧，我們

lyrics.ja: いつでも一緒だよ！
lyrics.romaji: Itsu demo Issho Da yo!
lyrics.en: We're always together!
lyrics.zh: 永遠都在一起！
